{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the 'revenue' column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders and exclude internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
completed_no_test = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue'] != 999999.99)]

# Compute total revenue
total_revenue = completed_no_test['revenue'].sum()

total_revenue"}
